```{r}
library(openxlsx2)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
setwd("~/data/plate layout RANDOM generator")

```
Generate Plate.

```{r}
set.seed(123)

# ---------------- PARAMETERS ----------------
n_donors <- 16
n_row <- 16
n_col <- 24

n_drug  <- 270
n_dmso  <- 24
n_pos   <- 16
n_cross_total <- 60

drug_ids <- paste0("Drug", sprintf("%03d", 1:n_drug))
pos_ids  <- paste0("PosCtrl_", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_pos))
donors   <- paste0("Donor", sprintf("%02d", 1:n_donors))

# ------------- PLATE TEMPLATE --------------
plate_template <- expand.grid(
  Row = LETTERS[1:n_row],
  Col = 1:n_col
)

plate_template$Well <- paste0(plate_template$Row, plate_template$Col)

# ---- 2x2 blocks at each corner (16 wells total) ----
corner_dmso <- c(
  # Top left
  "A1","A2","B1","B2",
  # Top right
  "A23","A24","B23","B24",
  # Bottom left
  "O1","O2","P1","P2",
  # Bottom right
  "O23","O24","P23","P24"
)

# Create workbook
wb <- wb_workbook()

# ------------- LOOP THROUGH DONORS ----------
for (d in donors) {

  plate <- plate_template
  
  plate$Donor <- d
  plate$Type <- "Empty"
  plate$ID <- NA
  
  # ----- DMSO -----
  # Sample n_dmso wells randomly across the plate (no corner restriction)
  dmso_wells <- sample(plate$Well, n_dmso)
  
  # ----- Positive controls -----
  remaining <- setdiff(plate$Well, dmso_wells)
  pos_wells <- sample(remaining, n_pos)
  
  # ----- Cross-donor duplicated -----
  remaining <- setdiff(remaining, pos_wells)
  
  other_donors <- setdiff(donors, d)
  cross_ids <- rep(other_donors, each = 2)
  
  cross_wells <- sample(remaining, n_cross_total)
  
  # ----- Drug wells -----
  remaining <- setdiff(remaining, cross_wells)
  drug_wells <- sample(remaining, n_drug)
  
  # ----- Assign -----
  plate$Type[plate$Well %in% dmso_wells] <- "DMSO"
  
  plate$Type[plate$Well %in% pos_wells] <- "Positive"
  plate$ID[plate$Well %in% pos_wells] <- pos_ids
  
  plate$Type[plate$Well %in% cross_wells] <- "CrossDonor"
  plate$ID[plate$Well %in% cross_wells] <- cross_ids
  
  plate$Type[plate$Well %in% drug_wells] <- "Drug"
  plate$ID[plate$Well %in% drug_wells] <- drug_ids
  
  # Add sheet
  wb$add_worksheet(d)
  wb$add_data(d, plate)
}

wb$save("384well_16Donor_FinalDesign.xlsx")


```
Export to Excel

```{r}
# SAVE FILE
wb$save("384well_16Donor_FinalDesign.xlsx")

```

Generate Plate Image

```{r}

plate <- read_xlsx("384well_16Donor_FinalDesign.xlsx", sheet = "Donor02")

plate_plot <- plate %>%
  mutate(Row = factor(Row, levels = rev(LETTERS[1:16])))

ggplot(plate_plot, aes(x = Col, y = Row, fill = Type)) +
  geom_tile(color = "black") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:24, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = c(0, 0)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Empty" = "white",
    "Positive" = "#FF6666",   # light red
    "Drug" = "#8DA0CBFF",     #6666FF
    "DMSO" = "#A6D854FF",
    "CrossDonor" = "#E5C494FF"
      )) +
  labs(
    title = "384-Well Plate Layout",
    x = "Column",
    y = "Row",
    fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 14),   # increase legend item font
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16)   # increase legend title font
  )

ggsave("Donor01_plate_layout.png",
       width = 10,
       height = 7,
       dpi = 600)


```
